crossRefs.note: Israel, return to Yahweh your God; for you have fallen because of your sin.
It was so because the children of Israel had sinned against Yahweh their God, who brought them up out of the land of…
He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul.
But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”
The look of their faces testify against them. They parade their sin like Sodom. They don’t hide it. Woe to their soul!…
Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them; for the deeds of his hands will be paid back to him.
“Haven’t you brought this on yourself, in that you have forsaken Yahweh your God, when he led you by the way?
“Your own wickedness will correct you, and your backsliding will rebuke you. Know therefore and see that it is an evil…
“Your way and your doings have brought these things to you. This is your wickedness; for it is bitter, for it reaches…
“Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withheld good from you.
“Now, please entreat the favor of God, that he may be gracious to us. With this, will he accept any of you?” says…
“Yet I am Yahweh your God from the land of Egypt; and you shall acknowledge no god but me, and besides me there is no…
“There is no one like God, Jeshurun, who rides on the heavens for your help, in his excellency on the skies.
Our soul has waited for Yahweh. He is our help and our shield.
God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?
My help comes from Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.
Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in Yahweh, his God:
Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the…
For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: You are destroyed, Israel, because you are against me, against your help.
translations.bsb: You are destroyed, O Israel, because you are against Me— against your helper.
translations.kjv: O Israel, thou hast destroyed thyself; but in me is thine help.
translations.asv: It is thy destruction, O Israel, that thou art against me, against thy help.
